code-ownership-audit 0.1.1

- Removed the file skill-card.md from the project.
- No functional or documentation changes introduced.

- Initial release of code-ownership-audit skill version 0.1.0.
- Determines if Python code is original or derivative, with detailed reporting.
- Identifies matching code expressions, exemption reasons, and risk levels.
- Provides both free preview (summary only) and paid full report (detailed, exportable, with certified receipt).
- All analysis runs offline; only payment requires network access.
- Includes paygate integration and clear user documentation for payment flows and dependencies.
